look.why: A fresh jungle-emerald pastel that frames its iridescent cobalt-blue neck and golden-green eyespot train.

size.measure: total length 1.8–2.3 m (male including 1.5 m train)

habitat.text: Open deciduous forests, scrublands, riverbanks and village edges across the Indian subcontinent.

diet.text: Seeds, berries, grain, insects, small reptiles and young snakes.

facts.text: Its famous 1.5-metre 'tail' is actually made of over 200 elongated upper-tail covert feathers—each tipped with a shimmering eyespot!
When displaying, the male rattles his feathers at 26 Hz, creating low-frequency infrasound vibrations felt by nearby peahens.

id.habitat: Hutan gugur terbuka, semak belukar, tepi sungai, dan pinggiran desa di anak benua India.
id.diet: Biji-bijian, beri, serangga, reptil kecil, dan anak ular.
facts: 'Ekor' terkenalnya yang sepanjang 1,5 meter sebenarnya terdiri dari lebih dari 200 bulu penutup ekor atas yang berujung motif mata!
Saat memikat betina, merak jantan menggetarkan bulunya pada 26 Hz, menghasilkan getaran infrasonik berfrekuensi rendah.
